blocks.name: Step Title
blocks.title: Where should the law firm reach you?

blocks.name: Text
blocks.text: Last step. Your answers go to one law firm only.

validations.errorMessage: Please enter a valid 10-digit U.S. mobile number.
Please enter a valid email address.

blocks.name: consent_checked
blocks.label: By checking this box and clicking "Submit," I give my express written consent for Prestige Legal Solutions, P.C. to contact me about my vehicle warranty and lemon law inquiry by calls, text messages, and emails at the phone number and email address I provided, including calls and texts that may use an automatic telephone dialing system, an artificial or prerecorded voice, or an AI-generated voice, even if my number is on a state or federal Do-Not-Call list. My consent is not a condition of hiring a lawyer or purchasing anything; instead, I can call the firm directly at {{PRESTIGE_INTAKE_PHONE}}. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. I can opt out at any time by replying STOP to any text or by telling the caller, and I can reply HELP for help. I have read the Privacy Policy.

validations.errorMessage: Please check the box to continue.

blocks.name: Text
blocks.text: Law firm: Prestige Legal Solutions, P.C., Los Angeles, California (licensed in Washington).

blocks.name: Text
blocks.text: Privacy notice: We collect your name, contact information, ZIP code, and answers about your vehicle to send your inquiry to the law firm named above. We don't sell your personal information or share it for cross-context behavioral advertising, and we send it to that one firm only. See our Privacy Policy.

blocks.name: Text
blocks.text: Your information has been sent to the law firm named in the consent you agreed to.

blocks.name: Text
blocks.text: Their intake team may call, text, or email you soon. If you'd like to reach them first, you can call {{PRESTIGE_INTAKE_PHONE}}.

blocks.name: Text
blocks.text: Tip: have your repair orders and your purchase or lease paperwork handy.

blocks.name: Text
blocks.text: Based on your answers, this inquiry doesn't fit what this service can take right now.

blocks.name: Text
blocks.text: That doesn't mean you don't have a claim, and it isn't legal advice about your situation. Washington's Attorney General has information about the state's lemon law at atg.wa.gov, and you may also want to talk with a lawyer of your choice. Legal claims can have deadlines, so it's best not to wait.
